name: kill keeps the seat
why: match.ts kill: the seat is no longer freed when a riding kong dies
find:
/\ seats' = IF Riding(p) THEN ExitSeats(p, veh[p]) ELSE seats
  /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![p] = "dead"]

name: freeSeat lets another squad in
why: vehicle.ts freeSeat: the squad check is gone
find: \/ \E k \in Seats : seats[v][k] # None /\ Team(seats[v][k]) # Team(p)

name: ejectAll leaves the riders on
why: match.ts ejectAll: the seats are cleared but the kongs still ride
find:
/\ st' = [p \in Players |-> IF Riding(p) /\ veh[p] = v /\ \E k \in Seats : seats[v][k] = p THEN "ground" ELSE st[p]]
  /\ veh' = [p \in Players |-> IF Riding(p) /\ veh[p] = v /\ \E k \in Seats : seats[v][k] = p THEN None ELSE veh[p]]
  /\ seat' = [p \in Players |-> IF Riding(p) /\ veh[p] = v /\ \E k \in Seats : seats[v][k] = p THEN 0 ELSE seat[p]]

name: a seat switch keeps the old seat
why: vehicle.ts switchSeat/takeSeat: the old seat is not freed
